properties.citation: Bennett, J. S., Mutch, E., Tollefson, A., et al. (2025). Cliopatria – A geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400BCE to 2024CE. Scientific Data 12, 247.
properties.accuracyNote: Source states coverage 3400 BCE–1000 CE is reviewed and corrected; CE 1000–2024 will be appended after review and attribute values may still change. Boundaries are scholarly approximations of polity extent, not precise legal borders.
properties.modifications: Geometry simplified for web rendering (ring thinning and 4-decimal coordinate rounding); original Name, Type, Wikipedia and AreaSqKM values are preserved. No boundary was invented or interpolated.
properties.note: Dataset-level provenance plus a per-polity Wikipedia link. These are scholarly approximations, not precise legal borders or primary historical sources.
